title: Lithic developer band
description: A pale mint panel with 24px corners, inset from the window edge: a two-line headline, a paragraph with a bold name in it and two arrow links on the left, and a large dark screenshot frame bleeding off the right and bottom edges. Emerald contour rings fan out from the top-left corner.
notes: uses secondary (mint) for the panel and chart-2 for the lines
